Everything an African artist needs to earn globally

AI Music Generation

Describe your sound in plain language and receive a production-ready track in seconds. Trained on African music genres from Amapiano to Afrobeats to Maskandi.

Global Distribution

One submission to Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, Boomplay, and 28 other platforms. Live within 24 hours.

Royalty Intelligence

Automatic SAMRO registration, per-stream tracking, and transparent earnings split. Your royalties, on time, every month.

Process

From idea to income in three steps

1

Describe your sound

Tell the AI what mood, genre, and feel you want. Reference artists, pick a tempo, hum a melody; the model reads all of it.

2

Review and publish

Preview the track, adjust the mix, add your cover art and metadata, then push to all your chosen platforms in one tap.

3

Collect royalties

Watch streams and earnings in real time. Royalties land in your account monthly with full SAMRO compliance handled automatically.
